note: Pathwidth was introduced by Robertson and Seymour in their 1983 work on graph minors. Research on pathwidth of cubic graphs began in the late 1980s and early 1990s, but the specific year and person who first posed the question 'What is the largest possible pathwidth of an n-vertex cubic graph?' could not be determined from available sources. The problem remains an open question with an established upper bound of n/6 and lower bound of approximately 0.082n.
